summary: Frontend-only regression/verification pass for the reload-indicator bug fix + damage-number polish (follow-up to iteration_12 PixiJS migration). Full flow re-verified: landing -> character create -> ENTER THE LAKE -> intro dialogue -> gameplay canvas, zero blocking errors. Naturally drained the starting hydropistol's magazine (held mouse-down fire across 3 separate runs) and captured the reload indicator via screenshots at the exact moment `player.reloading` flipped true: the revolver-cylinder graphic now renders ABOVE the character's head (not overlapping the gun), is a clean round circle with a border, sits beside clear 'RELOADING' text, and NO stray line/artifact was visible in any of the ~15 screenshots taken during multiple reload cycles (bug considered FIXED). Code review of pixiRenderer.js confirms `.moveTo()` now precedes every `.arc()` call both in the reload spinner block (line ~469) and in `_drawParticles`'s 'arc' melee-swing particle (lines ~692-698) -- the root cause class is fixed at both sites. Damage numbers: naturally triggered a hit (dmgNums pool entry with text '15'), observed it appear near the enemy with visible fade-out as life decreased across successive frames; the pop/overshoot-scale code in `_drawDamageNumbers` was reviewed and is correctly implemented (age-based overshoot then settle). No new console errors/exceptions in any run (only the pre-existing, previously-documented WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' performance driver warning, and the already-understood FPS-decline-under-load artifact from iteration_12, neither of which is a regression from this session's changes). Note: could not naturally reach a non-hydropistol weapon reload (no level-up card offering autoBolts/shotgun appeared within the short test window) -- this variant was NOT re-verified via natural gameplay this pass; code review of the isRevolver branch (checks p._reloadWid against 'hydropistol'/'hydropistol_evo') shows correct logic and the main agent had already visually confirmed it via direct state injection per the task context, so this is a low-risk gap, not a blocking concern.
action_items: Optional/low-priority: main agent could do a quick natural-gameplay check of the spinner (non-revolver) reload variant by picking up autoBolts/shotgun via a level-up card in a longer run, since this pass only reached that state via forced-state injection (which produced inconclusive screenshots due to page.evaluate causing frame-time jumps in the render loop, not an app bug) -- not required given prior direct-state-injection verification already done by main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: pixiRenderer.js reload block (lines ~445-477): correctly uses `.moveTo()` before `.arc()` for the spinning-ring case (non-revolver), and builds the revolver cylinder via `.circle()` calls only (no bare .arc()) -- consistent with the root-cause fix.
_drawParticles 'arc' particle type (lines ~688-699): both .arc() calls (main sweep and tip flash) are now preceded by explicit .moveTo() -- same bug class fixed here too, matches the stated scope.

_drawDamageNumbers (lines ~708-733) pop animation formula `1 + max(0, 0.55 - age*4.5)` decays to 1.0 by ~age=0.122s, giving a fast, subtle overshoot -- reasonable and matches 'nicer, not flat' intent; alpha fade `min(1, life*2)` fades out correctly in the final 0.5s of the ~0.8s lifetime.

engine.js startReload() now stores reloadTotal/_reloadMag/_reloadWid on the player object at reload-start time -- clean approach that avoids weapon-table lookups in the render loop; no state leakage observed across multiple reload cycles in testing (mag correctly cycled 12->0->12 across two consecutive drains).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reload-indicator bug fix and damage-number polish both verified working via natural gameplay (hold-fire to drain hydropistol's 12-round mag triggers reload in ~8-10s of continuous fire at default fire rate). window.__game exposes engine state; game.enemies and game.dmgNums are Pool objects (not plain arrays) -- use .forEach(item => ...) not iteration, and check item.alive !== false when iterating. Forcing p.reloading=true via page.evaluate() for screenshot purposes is unreliable for this game's render loop (causes frame-time-delta spikes that snap the reload to completion before the screenshot fires) -- prefer natural gameplay triggers over state injection for this particular visual. Non-revolver (spinner) reload variant still not naturally verified across two testing sessions now; if a future pass has more time, consider using cheat/debug menu (if one exists) to instantly grant autoBolts/shotgun rather than waiting for a random level-up card.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: PIXI Graphics .arc() call without a preceding .moveTo() on a Graphics object that already had other shapes drawn that frame caused Pixi's path builder to connect the previous shape's last point to the arc's start point, drawing a visible stray line. Fix verified present in code at both call sites (reload spinner + melee-swing arc particle) via direct code review, and the fix's visual effect (no stray line) was confirmed empirically across ~15 reload-indicator screenshots captured during 2 separate natural-gameplay drain-and-reload cycles.
